results.caption: Should you honeymoon in Curaçao? Here's our honest review after actually staying there. We spent ours at @Avila Beach Hotel - Curaçao in the Oceanfront Blues room.  Everything we loved, and the stuff we'd tell any couple before they book. Thank you Avila for partnering with us on this trip and making our honeymoon what it was. Every opinion in here is still 100% ours, unfiltered. Where we stayed: Avila Beach Hotel, Oceanfront Blues room Where we went:  - Willemstad - Westpunt - Landhuis Klein Santa Martha  - Santa Martha Bay View Lookout - Klein Curaçao with BlueFinn Charters Save this one if Curaçao is on your list 🇨🇼 #curacao #curacaotravel #honeymoon #honeymoondestination #caribbeanhoneymoon
The biggest lie we are told is that it isn’t that simple

You might’ve heard about it from watching the World Cup. Curaçao is the smallest nation to ever qualify for the World Cup, and it was so hype. Game day on the island was electric, and even though they had a tough loss against Germany, when that goal went in, the entire island erupted. So much fun. Also, their schedule was insane. What the heck Willemstad was a 10-minute walk from where we stayed at Avila Beach Hotel. Definitely recommend staying there. They have great food and facilities. The town itself is so colorful and has a really cool bridge that is basically just a boat and drives open and closed. We rented a car through Budget Car Rental in the lobby and took day trips to Westpunt, about an hour away, where some of the best beaches on the island are. We ate at Playa Forti, which is on a cliff, and they have an area you can jump off if you are adventurous enough. The water, of course, is insane. Our favorite thing we did was a boat tour through BlueFinn Tours, which had awesome food and was so much fun. Klein Curaçao deserves a video of its own. They have chairs for you to sit on on the gorgeous beach, and the island itself has an abandoned lighthouse and shipwrecks you can explore. Some hidden gems are the Santa Martha Bay lookout and the nearby restaurant that also overlooks the bay, Landhuis Klein Santa Martha. They have awesome traditional food. We will definitely be back, and make sure to save this for your Curaçao trip! Honeymoon review coming soon! #Curacao #CuracaoTravel #VisitCuracao #Willemstad #KleinCuracao

Honestly not bad.  Pretty chill zone 1 workout just insanely long.  Here’s the full story.  Do you think @Chris C needs to come to Mallorca?  Never swam more than 100 yards. Never biked more than 5 miles. Ran a couple marathons years ago and that’s it. Carb loading the day before did not go well. Basically no breakfast, pancakes for lunch, pasta for dinner, almost a gallon of apple juice. Ended up feeling sick most of the night and barely slept. Woke up rough and still got moving anyway. It’s not a hard day physically, it’s just really long and really boring. I was live on Instagram almost the entire time, which is also why my phone survived since I couldn’t charge it while running.  The only logistical way to fit a run, bike, and swim into one day was to do it in and around my apartment complex. Paced it close to the cutoff times on purpose. Could’ve gone faster but didn’t want to burn out. Did it anyway. Turns out it’s not hard, it’s just really long and really boring. #ironman #ironmantraining #ironmantriathlon #fullironman

Easiest, longest, most boring zone one workout of my life  Finished well within the cut off times including my transitions 2.5 hours for the swim, 10.5 hours for the swim and bike and under 17 hours for everything. Took it slow and easy and just paced for 10-20 minutes before cutoff. Wish I hadn’t because the day was boringgggg.   I also bought bike shorts for this Absolutely no training. Never swam more than 100 yards. Never biked more than 5 miles (two days prior to see if it was possible) and yeah I’ve run a couple marathons but I have only run a handful of times this year.  When my buddy @Chris C challenged me to do it I thought there is no way I can’t do it because I have such a long time to. 17 hours is forever bro they got to make it shorter.  The only logistical way for me to get a run a bike and a swim in was to do it in and around my apartment complex.  I paced to do it as close to the time limits as possible. Definitely could’ve gone faster but didn’t want to burn out as I had never done it. Oh and I did a terrible job carb loading (I started the day before) which consisted of no breakfast, pancakes for lunch, pasta for dinner, and almost a gallon of apple juice. I got food poisoning somehow and threw up all night every last bit of the pasta. Didn’t sleep and was either freezing or super hot and in a pool of sweat. After I got up I was walking to the pool and had to run out to the front of the apartment to throw up all of the water I drank that morning and straight stomach acid. Still ripped it. You have no excuse it isn’t hard it is just really long and boring.  Oh and I was live on Instagram the whole day with the exception of the second half of the marathon so my phone didn’t die since it couldn’t be plugged in as I ran.  Thank you to everyone who tuned in! And a special thank you to Chris who pulled up to watch my marathon and @miguel_villaca who came and checked on me after my live went down and even got some miles in without running for years. Absolute legends . #ironman #ironmantraining #ironmantriathlon #fullironman
